title.en: JianyingPro downloaded materials and app data
title.zh: 剪映专业版下载的素材和应用数据

explain.en: Effects, music, text templates, online materials and speech models JianyingPro downloaded, plus its own material index, cloud-draft data and AI material records. Your drafts point at some of these files, material no longer offered online may not come back, and some may be things you made in JianyingPro, so Hoardless only shows the size.
explain.zh: 剪映专业版下载的特效、音乐、文字模板、在线素材和语音模型，以及剪映自己的素材索引、云草稿数据和 AI 素材记录。你的草稿直接引用其中一些文件，已下架的素材删了可能找不回来，有些还可能是你在剪映里生成的内容，所以只显示大小。

evidence.note: JianyingPro 11.5.0 (com.lemon.lvpro) on the maintainer's Mac: inside User Data/Cache, effect 2.22 GB, music 0.87 GB, AITextTemplate 0.66 GB (json, ttf, zip), local_models 0.33 GB (speech-recognition model), artistEffect 0.26 GB, ressdk_db 0.16 GB (SQLite), ILASDKDB 0.06 GB, onlineMaterial 0.07 GB and smaller AI/cloud folders; the app's own User Data/Config/globalSetting sets currentCachePath to that Cache folder. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: The cache folder can be moved in the app (currentCachePath in globalSetting, read via app_settings). Folders the app rebuilds are in jianying-generated-cache. Not covered: about 60 Cache subfolders under 5 MB (about 18 MB together) and loose files in Cache (rp.db, gecko.db and their -wal/-shm files, which must never be moved apart from each other). Not tested, on purpose: removing these could make an autosaved draft lose a template or material. More caches (prerender, RemuxCache) live in ~/Library/Containers/com.lemon.lvpro and are not covered. No official documentation found. Not tested whether drafts recover these materials after removal, so they stay protected.
